name: security-scan-pack

rights: Original clean-room marketplace text authored for this repository. No file from openai/plugins/plugins/codex-security was copied into this pack.

interface.shortDescription: Clean-room security scan workflows for repo scanning, receipts, and reports.
interface.longDescription: Clean-room security scan workflows for repository orchestration, threat modeling, candidate discovery, validation receipts, attack-path and severity analysis, and final markdown reporting. Uses repo-owned governance and permissively licensed scanner references instead of the proprietary openai/plugins/plugins/codex-security root.
defaultPrompt: Use the Security Scan Pack to plan the scan, pick the right licensed tools, and keep receipts deterministic.
Capture the threat model and coverage ledger before summarizing findings.
Prefer repo-owned text and current official scanner docs over memory.
